description: Run one of PixelDojo's one-click effects on your photos: the prompt is built in, so pass only the slug from pixeldojo_effects and the photos (image_urls, or image_paths for local files), plus texts for tools that ask for them. Video effects return a 5 s clip (usually handed off; poll with pixeldojo_status), photo effects and tools an image. Costs the credits the listing shows.

engine.description: Photo effects only: leave out for the default engine.

family.description: Needed only for action-figure, comic-book and red-carpet, which are both a video and a photo effect.

image_paths.description: Absolute local photo paths instead of image_urls; uploaded first (24h temp storage).

image_urls.description: The photos as https URLs, in the order the listing names them (most take one; duo effects take two).

slug.description: The effect slug from pixeldojo_effects, e.g. "ai-hug", "action-figure", "watermark-remover".

texts.description: Text inputs in listing order, for entries that list them (object to remove, new background, brand name).

name: pixeldojo_effect
title: Run one-click effect
